messages:
nina: Quick sync: pilots keep asking for a compact Console view that correlates errors with cost and gives a short 'why' pointer (recent deploys/top traces). I propose an MVP 'Error-Cost Compass' to ship fast. Thoughts?
omar: Three launch surfaces: single-pane dashboard (route + tenant filter), a correlation alert, and nightly CSV export for billing ops. Keep scope tight.
jyoti: CSV + a small 'why' card (last deploys + top stack frames) is high value for customers. Can runtime provide deploy metadata?
ben: Yes, runtime emits deploy_id + route + model_version. We'll add span annotations only (no full-span dumps). Sampling: default 0.5%, bump to 5% on anomaly. Retention 7d.
claire: Draft ACs: 1) Dashboard top 20 routes by error delta with cost delta column (24h vs 6h) + tenant filter. 2) Correlation alert: error_rate > 2.5x baseline AND cost_growth >=4% in 30m -> creates ticket with links. 3) Export per-tenant CSV of top routes + deltas. 4) 'Why' card shows last 5 deploys and top stack fingerprint.
nina: Implementation notes: ingest aggregated counters + sampled trace metadata (trace_id, deploy_id, short stack fingerprint). No long-term trace storage at launch.
omar: Rollout plan: feature flag 'error_cost_compass' -> 5% tenants 24h, then 25% 72h, then GA. Start with alerting off for first 48h of canary.
jyoti: Customers also asked for per-tenant retention control; mark as post-GA. For MVP provide org-level feature flag.
ben: Work estimates: tracing annotations PR (2w), ingestion/schema (1w), dashboard+CSV (1w), alerting glue (0.5w), rollout automation (0.5w). Parallelize tasks for ~4w elapsed.
claire: Tradeoffs: no deep forensic flows, no long-term retention, limited sampling. Low cost and quicker ship.
flag-bot: flag-bot: Created feature flag 'error_cost_compass' in ff-service. Add rollout steps in RFC.
nina: Next: I'll write RFC with ACs, rollout steps, ticket list and schedule 30m review Thursday 9am. If no blockers we'll kick work.
omar: Thanks all.
claire: Adding customer ask document to RFC.
ben: I'll open tracing PR draft and link it in RFC.
nina: Closing thread.
